fields.name: ArgentSea.Orleans.Pg Queries catalogue and PgFunctionQuery
fields.contract: ArgentSea.Orleans.Pg.Queries exposes fourteen static members, each composing a fresh equal instance on access. Writes are QueryProcedure members naming version-1 wtr procedures (run by Npgsql as CALL with named p_ arguments): OrleansClusterInsertMemberVersion, OrleansClusterInsertMember, OrleansClusterUpdateMember, OrleansClusterUpdateIAmAliveTime, OrleansClusterDeleteDefunctMembers, OrleansClusterDelete, OrleansReminderDeleteRow, OrleansReminderUpsertRow. Reads are PgFunctionQuery members (CommandType.Text whose text is only SELECT * FROM calls of version-1 rdr functions with @p_ placeholders, one statement per result set): OrleansClusterGatewayList, OrleansClusterMemberReadAll (three statements), OrleansClusterMemberReadRow (two statements), OrleansReminderReadRow, OrleansReminderReadRows, OrleansReminderReadRangeRows. PgFunctionQuery(name, sql) is a public Query subclass for such function calls.
